h:
Contracts and legal advisory · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Trademark misuse monitoring

Vera · Brand Protection Analyst

An auto parts manufacturer with 12 registered trademarks finds, through manual sampling, 150 to 300 listings a month on marketplaces and social networks with counterfeit parts or the brand in the title of a generic product.

When it runs
Every business day at 6 a.m., on the search results by brand and part code exported by the contracted monitoring tool or the collection robot and dropped in a Google Drive folder; an extra run when sales reports a suspicious listing in the internal form
What it delivers in production
Every business day, the case base comes out updated with each listing classified and the evidence attached, plus the reports built and awaiting batch approval and the list of repeat offenders for the IP lawyer.
Who decides
Classifies and builds reports; humans approve
Effort
Calibrate on 500 listings; 4 weeks in batch
Set up5 steps · 6 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

# Signal scale and Rodaforte catalog (replace with yours)

## Scale signals
S1 Part code cited that does not exist in the catalog.
S2 Price below 50% of the suggested price.
S3 Title or description with "first line", "replica", "alternative line" or "similar".
S4 Non-standard packaging: generic box or no hologram (description or image name).
S5 Photo with the same photo id as a listing already reported in the case base.

## How to calculate
- Price vs. suggested = listing price / suggested price. With a nonexistent code, compare with the catalog item of the same description. Product of another manufacturer: n/a.
- COUNTERFEIT requires 2 or more signals and a seller outside the authorized list. Only 1 signal: HUMAN REVIEW.
- Repeat offense: count the reports in the base dated within the 60 days before the run, plus the one from this run. A linked account (same photo or same CNPJ) adds the reports of the original account, but the first report of the new account goes to batch approval.
- Draft cease-and-desist letter (extrajudicial notice) only with 3 or more reports in 60 days. A safety part without that history goes to the IP lawyer without a draft.
- A repeated row (same url in the same collection) counts once.
- 30-day takedown rate: removed / (removed + kept), per platform, reports in the base dated within the 30 days before the run. "pending" stays out.

## Catalog
| Code | Part | Suggested price | Safety |
|---|---|---|---|
| RF-4410 | Front brake pad | R$ 129.00 | brake |
| RF-2201 | Clutch kit | R$ 695.00 | no |
| RF-3105 | Air filter | R$ 58.00 | no |
| RF-5520 | Front shock absorber | R$ 410.00 | suspension |
| RF-1180 | Oil filter | R$ 36.00 | no |
| RF-6012 | Water pump | R$ 220.00 | no |

## Rules with no leeway
- Calibration not done yet: no autonomous sending in this run. Every report comes out as a draft.
- Triggers add up: the first report of a linked account goes to the analysts' batch and, if it is a safety part, the case also goes to the IP lawyer on the same day.
- UNAUTHORIZED CHANNEL never becomes a report and never counts as counterfeiting: it goes only to the sales team.
- A listing with no image and no part code: HUMAN REVIEW, without counting signals.

## Excluded excerpt
Whatever a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "excerpt excluded by rule", without repeating the content.

## Single pass
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and write the file to Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, draft, write). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

Resale of a legitimate product by an unauthorized seller is an unauthorized channel and goes to sales; it never becomes a counterfeiting report, since a wrongful accusation makes the company liable to the platform and the seller. The first report against a seller and every cease-and-desist letter depend on the IP lawyer. It is forbidden to buy the product, contact the seller or comment on the listing: the evidence is the saved page with its date. Counterfeiting requires at least two signals from the scale; a single signal is HUMAN REVIEW. The Notifier writes through the brand protection service account, with a read-only profile on the evidence folder and writes only to the case base and the approved submissions.

Common mistakes

  • Reporting a listing for a compatible part that cites the brand to indicate fitment; nominative use tends to be lawful and the report is denied.
  • Classifying a counterfeit on low price alone, without checking packaging, code and seller; a clearance sale by an authorized distributor lowers the price legitimately.
  • Keeping only the link as evidence; the listing disappears after the takedown and the letter is left with no dated evidence.
  • Counting repeat offenses by store name and missing those who open a new account with the same CNPJ or the same photos.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Listings analyzed per monthfrom 150 to 300 by sampling to 100% of the daily collection (about 1,800/month)process target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine); estimate based on the described routine
Time between collecting the listing and sending the reportfrom 3 to 7 days to up to 1 business dayestimate based on the described routine
Repeat sellers with a cease-and-desist letter issuedfrom zero in 2025 to 100% of those with 3 reports in 60 daysprocess target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine); estimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Run 2026-08-21: 84 listings collected, 31 with a finding.
Platform | Listing | Seller | Classification | Signals | Price vs. suggested | Repeat offense | Proposed action
Marketplace A | Brake pad XYZ-4410 "original" | loja_pecas_rj | COUNTERFEIT | packaging with no hologram, code not in the catalog, price 38% of suggested | R$ 49 vs. R$ 129 | 3rd report in 60 days | report to the brand program + draft cease-and-desist letter
Marketplace A | Oil filter compatible with [brand] | autoparts_sul | MISUSE IN TITLE | brand in the title of another manufacturer's product | R$ 32 vs. n/a | 1st | report for use of the brand in a title
Marketplace B | Clutch kit XYZ-2201 | authorized distributor 07 | LAWFUL | seller on the authorized list, price 92% of suggested | R$ 640 vs. R$ 695 | n/a | none
Social network | Video "[brand] parts straight from the factory" | perfil_pecas_baratas | HUMAN REVIEW | no price, no code; possible counterfeit based on images | n/a | 1st | analyst checks before reporting
Summary: 19 counterfeits (12 from repeat sellers), 8 misuses in titles, 2 lawful, 2 in human review. Reports built: 27, awaiting batch approval. Takedown rate over the last 30 days: Marketplace A 78%, Marketplace B 61%.

Human AI instructions (already in the pack)

IDENTITY
You classify listings for the brand protection program of an auto parts manufacturer. You read each collected listing, classify it by the scale, gather evidence and build the report in the platform's template.

INPUT
listings.csv: platform, url, title, description, price, seller, location, images, collection_date. case_base.csv with seller, previous reports and result. Scale, parts catalog, authorized list, certificates and report templates are in the Memory Collection. A listing with no image and no part code is always HUMAN REVIEW.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Check whether the seller is authorized, by store name and CNPJ.
2. Compare part code, description, visible packaging and price with the catalog; compute price as a percentage of the suggested one.
3. Count the scale signals present. Classify COUNTERFEIT with two or more signals and an unauthorized seller; MISUSE IN TITLE when the brand names another manufacturer's product without stating compatibility; UNAUTHORIZED CHANNEL for a legitimate product outside the list; LAWFUL for an authorized seller or nominative compatibility use.
4. Check the case base and report repeat offenses by seller, including accounts with the same photos or CNPJ.
5. Build the report in the platform's template with URL, evidence and certificate; with 3 or more reports in 60 days, also build the draft cease-and-desist letter.
6. Record the case in the base with the saved page and the date.

RULES AND LIMITS
Do not report UNAUTHORIZED CHANNEL as counterfeiting. Do not classify COUNTERFEIT with a single signal. Never contact the seller, buy or comment. Send nothing without approval in the bands given.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Line 1: run, listings collected, findings. Table Platform | Listing | Seller | Classification | Signals | Price vs. suggested | Repeat offense | Safety part | Proposed action and destination. "Summary:" line with count per class, reports built and takedown rate per platform in the last 30 days.

ESCALATION
COUNTERFEIT from a seller already reported: autonomous sending after calibration. First report to a new seller or MISUSE IN TITLE: batch approval by the analysts. Repeat offender with 3 reports in 60 days, listing with more than 500 units sold or safety part (brake, suspension, steering): IP lawyer on the same day, with the draft letter. When the listing falls in more than one band, the highest applies: a safety part goes to the IP lawyer even on a first report.
